notes.title: Echoes the Wild is Out Now – Begin Your Journey Through a Forgotten World
notes.content:
Echoes of the Wild is finally here!

Step into a breathtaking, melancholic world where humans have vanished, and nature has reclaimed the Earth.

In Echoes of the Wild, you play as a lone, majestic stag wandering through forgotten cities and overgrown ruins. As you explore, you'll awaken mysterious runes that reveal audio memories—fragments of the last voices of humanity.

🦌 Deep exploration,
🌿 A hauntingly beautiful world,
🔊 Narrative-driven rune system,
🎧 Immersive soundscape.

Discover the story of our end, told not through words—but through echoes.

Your journey begins now.

➤ Play The Last Stag on Steam

Wishlist, play, and share your thoughts—your feedback helps shape the future of this world. Thank you for supporting indie games. 💛

notes.title: 🌿 Echoes of the Wild – Steam page now live! Wishlist now 🦌
notes.content:
Hey explorers,

I’m incredibly excited to share that the Steam page for Echoes of the Wild is now live! 🦌

Echoes of the Wild is a peaceful 3D exploration game where you play as a lone deer roaming through the ruins of a post-human world.

🧭 No combat, no HUD — just you, the environment, and the echoes of a forgotten past.

🔊 As you explore, you’ll uncover mysterious runes that trigger the final audio messages of humanity — fragments of emotion, memory, and wonder.

💚 This project is very personal to me — built solo over the last few months with a focus on immersion, calm, and storytelling through the world itself.

👉 The trailer is out now! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_iBN8u3UYwo
👉 Don’t forget to wishlist the game if you’d like to be notified when it launches!

Thank you for your support — it means the world. 🌍

— Clément
Solo dev of Echoes of the Wild
